findings.message: Up to 60 printable bytes of a long index line are echoed into the model context. Accepted: the excerpt identifies the entry to trim.
Path rule allows .. segments and symlinks; marker key falls back to cksum. Hook only reads size and line counts. Accepted.
With jq absent the hook prints a line and exits 1 on every Write, Edit or MultiEdit, before the path is known. Accepted.
printable strips control bytes and leaves the printable tail of an escape sequence. Harmless; no change.
Path rule also matches a project-local memory/MEMORY.md. Accepted.
ensure skips a same-command entry, so an install made from 4e99b7f would keep the Write|Edit matcher. Accepted: 4e99b7f was never installed or pushed.
memory_index_hook_registered is printed; no fixture asserts it and false does not fail the doctor. Accepted for this change.
A missing file after a matching write exits 0 without a trace. Accepted.
Missing-jq notice exits 1, shown only in verbose mode. Accepted.
